# dsh-skill-curator
Automatic skill curation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). After every N real conversation turns (default
**3**), the plugin fires a background **subagent** that reads a digest of the session and **edits, m
erges, prunes and creates `SKILL.md` files** under the user skills directory (`~/.dsh/skills/`) — th
e same self-improvement loop Nous Research's Hermes Agent runs, ported to DSH as a zero-intrusion bu
improvement loop Nous Research's Hermes Agent runs, ported to DSH as a zero-intrusion bundle plugin.

## Requirements

- **Verified host**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.2.2-rc.1` (Node v24); 0.2.1-rc.2 was real-m

achine verified end to end (`/skill-refine`).
- **Why the disjunction is load-bearing**: npm semver
only satisfies a prerelease from a range group that itself contains a prerelease with the same `[maj
or,minor,patch]` tuple, so the plain `<0.2.0` group does **not** cover `0.1.5-rc.1` or `0.1.7-rc.2`,
and the `0.2.0-alpha.0` group does **not** cover `0.2.1-rc.2` or `0.2.2-rc.1` (their tuples are new
er). `test/entry.test.mjs` pins this with a decision table, a counter-proof (reverting to the older

range turns red), and a cross-check against the host's real `semver.satisfies`.
- **0.1.7 settings c
ontract (what this adaptation was about)**: `settings.installSection` was removed from dsh-settings.
The namespace **is** the cordis row id, `Config` must be exported from the plugin module, and every
live-editable field must be `.volatile()` (the host's `_commitVolatile` rewrites the live reference
in place, no fiber restart). The settings card therefore hangs off `configForms.get(ns)` and the `p

lugins.item` slot.
- **No install scripts, no gyp/native deps**: the whole tree is plain ESM; `test/
entry.test.mjs` guards this (no `install`/`postinstall`/`prepare`, no `optionalDependencies`, depend
ency scope limited to `@deepseek-ai/*`).

## dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 compatibility notes

Verified against the DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` desktop runtime by comparing against its unpacked
asar sources

and by exercising the plugin end-to-end. **0.2.1 packs several breaking
changes** — clearing the co
mpatibility gate is not enough on its own:

- **The gate is only the entry ticket.** `dsh-subagent` **no longer exports `settleRun`**
from its p

ackage root (only `settleRunResult`; the implementation moved into
`lib/types/run-settlement.js` but

is not reachable through the `exports` map).
A top-level `import { settleRun }` throws a `SyntaxErr

or` at **ESM link time**, so
`apply()` never runs and the **entire plugin silently dies** — the host

only logs a
single warning. Fix: inline `settleRun` (`src/run-settlement.js`), aligned statement
by

statement with the host's semantics.
- **`subagents.start()` was removed** in favour of `startActiv

ation(spec)` (whose spec
carries an extra `request` layer). Branch at runtime on "is the method pres

ent" rather
than betting on a version number. Note that `startActivation`'s `signal` **covers
admiss

ion only** — a timeout must `dispose()` explicitly or the review hangs until the
built-in 15-minute

self-timeout.
- **The tool whitelist moved from the `request` layer to the Agent Preset layer.**
`st

artLocal` only writes `composition: { agentPreset }`, so locally spawned subagents
never see `reques

t.toolFilter`; meanwhile `dsh-tool-subagent` throws outright on
`config.toolFilter` and points you a

t a preset. The plugin therefore declares its own
internal preset (`skill-curator-review`) mounting

`src/preset-guard.js`, which calls
`tools.restrict({ allow })` inside the subagent's own scope.

The preset guard must wait for a readiness marker.** `restrict()` validates names
